title: MIT dream implantation technology

tellings.link_reason: The same MIT technical applications for dream implantation, including at a distance, told by Brown.

plain: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology, known as MIT, is said to have published technical applications on implanting dreams in people's minds, including from a distance. Matthew Brown, described in the episode as a Pentagon whistleblower, mentions this twice and frames it as recent, public work anyone can look up, which would mean such mind-influencing technology is already being developed openly.
